questionBankSnapshot.action: No bulk question generation; strengthen indication-specific authority routing and rule-sensitive provenance.

policy: Preserve the existing BRPT/AASM/AAST authority hierarchy. Oxygen is not one algorithm. Route by indication, distinguish treatment authority from technologist workflow, and require physician order/facility/manufacturer overlays where execution is local or device-specific.

therapyRoutes.boundary: Order and indication first; no generic D4C starting-flow or target rule.

therapyRoutes.route: Supplemental oxygen during OSA PAP titration
therapyRoutes.boundary: PAP-specific oxygen thresholds/steps must not be generalized to other oxygen indications.

therapyRoutes.route: Adult CSA due to heart failure
therapyRoutes.boundary: AASM 2025 treatment recommendation is indication-specific and clinician-directed.

therapyRoutes.route: Adult CSA due to high altitude
therapyRoutes.boundary: AASM 2025 treatment recommendation is indication-specific and clinician-directed.
Oxygenation and ventilation are not interchangeable; CO2 monitoring/scoring remains a separate pathway.
No universal pediatric oxygen algorithm; current AASM pediatric/infant rules and age-specific local protocol come first.
Facility policy, state law/scope, order, and manufacturer requirements are mandatory execution overlays.
Document oxygen context without allowing saturation response to replace separate respiratory/ventilation interpretation.

explicitNonRules: No universal oxygen titration algorithm across all D4C indications.
PAP-titration oxygen thresholds are not automatically applicable to standalone oxygen, CSA, hypoventilation, pediatric/infant, or other indications.
Improved oxygen saturation does not by itself establish adequate ventilation.
Do not hard-code a universal facility maximum oxygen flow or emergency threshold into learner logic.

remainingGaps.topic: Facility-specific oxygen protocols and device/manufacturer instructions
remainingGaps.handling: V3 should teach the boundary and required verification step, not invent local execution details.
